The $60 trillion in missing inheritance: Here's what to know
Baby boomers are expected to transfer around 100 trillion dollars in wealth inheritance in the coming decades, but Visa is warning that number could be a lot smaller. CNBC's Robert Frank joins 'Squawk Box' to explain why.
